topic.title: Warranty Information
topic.shortdesc: Understand the terms and conditions of your XSmartHomeHub product warranty.

body.p: Your XSmartHomeHub includes a 2-year limited warranty from the date of purchase.
This warranty covers manufacturing defects under normal usage conditions.
To claim warranty, retain your proof of purchase and contact customer support.
Damage due to misuse, power surges, or unauthorized modifications is not covered.
